# Utopic RX — DESi Smart Locks UAE & GCC
> Utopic RX is the UAE and GCC retail brand for DESi (Türkiye) modular retrofit smart door locks. Keyless smart locks that mount over an existing euro-cylinder with no drilling and no door modification. Built for renters, Airbnb hosts, property managers, and offices in Dubai and the wider GCC.

## Products
- [Smart Lock — Homepage](https://utopicrx.com/): DESi Utopic RX AI-powered retrofit smart lock for UAE renters. No drilling, no modification, installs in 3 minutes.
- [Utopic RX Product Page](https://utopicrx.com/products/utopic-rx.html): Full specs for the DESi Utopic RX smart lock.
- [All Products](https://utopicrx.com/products/index.html): Smart lock accessories — face reader, fingerprint, WiFi bridge, door sensor, and more.

- [Smart Lock FAQ](https://utopicrx.com/faq): Answers for UAE renters and homeowners.

## Key facts
- Retrofit design: mounts over existing euro-cylinder, leaves no trace on removal
- Access methods: face recognition, fingerprint, PIN code, app (DESi Smart), e-key sharing
- Renter-safe: compliant with Dubai tenancy law, no landlord permission required for a reversible device
- Delivery: UAE stock, fast Dubai delivery
- Support: support@utopicrx.com
